text:
Noah (Support): flagging a spike: three customers opened support tickets today about an unfamiliar charge with descriptor "Redwood Infr Service" and same $49.99 amount. All three provided bank dispute IDs.

Noah (Support): Customer list: CUST-9921 dispute_id=DB-7781, CUST-9932 dispute_id=DB-7782, CUST-9943 dispute_id=DB-7783. All report not-authorized.

Ravi (Risk): thanks. pattern looks like card-testing + subsequent subscription creation. can we confirm txn IPs and API keys used? we should check onboarding funnel for proxied signups.

Jesse (Finance): are charges posted as subscription charges or one-offs? need charge IDs to start dispute evidence.

Maya (BillingOps): pulling charges now. matches as one-off charge on invoice INV-2026-04-11-99 for each account. Stripe charges: ch_1MTestA111, ch_1MTestB222, ch_1MTestC333. All status: succeeded.

billing-bot: webhook: charge.dispute.created for ch_1MTestA111 at 2026-04-11T14:02:45Z (dispute DB-7781)

Noah (Support): each customer says they never created these accounts; they were auto-created via API with email patterns like test+random@domain.com.

Ravi (Risk): confirmed: same API key used across the three accounts: sk_live_XXXX_compromised. origin IPs: 203.0.113.12, 203.0.113.12, 198.51.100.7. That suggests automated tooling from two IPs. Correlate with account creation times.

Jesse (Finance): good. For chargeback evidence we need: proof of service (API logs showing create model calls), IPs, API key, invoice line items, customer-support correspondence, refund history if any. Also need merchant descriptor and statement descriptors.

Maya (BillingOps): assembling evidence packet. adding: invoice PDFs, API request logs, provisioning traces, and support transcripts. marking accounts for billing hold and disabling the compromised API key.

Noah (Support): notifying affected customers about hold + refund offer. one customer already replied they authorize a refund but want the case escalated.

Ravi (Risk): please escalate to FraudOps. recommend revoking sk_live_XXXX_compromised and searching other accounts created by that key. add a flag to reject future payments from same card fingerprint.

billing-bot: api-key.revoke event processed for sk_live_XXXX_compromised at 2026-04-11T15:10:03Z

Maya (BillingOps): Evidence packet draft attached to internal ticket: EP-2026-04-11-17. Contents:
```
- merchant_descriptor: Redwood Inference
- statement_descriptor: REDWOOD*INF
- invoices: INV-2026-04-11-99, INV-2026-04-11-101, INV-2026-04-11-103
- charges: ch_1MTestA111, ch_1MTestB222, ch_1MTestC333
- api_logs: create_account/charge calls (timestamps + ip list)
- provisioning: no resource consumption; trial credits not applied
- customer_communications: support transcripts
- risk_analysis: identical user agent, repeated short interval signups
```

Jesse (Finance): looks solid. I will submit evidence to the issuing banks via Stripe dispute_response API and request retrieval. note that banks sometimes decide against us; still submit everything. approve issuing full refunds immediately and mark invoices as refunded to avoid further disputes.

Noah (Support): customers confirmed they'd accept refunds. proceeding to issue.

billing-bot: refund created rf_1MRefundAAA for ch_1MTestA111 (pending)

Maya (BillingOps): refunds processed: rf_1MRefundAAA, rf_1MRefundBBB, rf_1MRefundCCC (succeeded). updated invoices and added notes: "Refund issued due to suspected unauthorized API key usage; evidence packet EP-2026-04-11-17 submitted to bank."

Ravi (Risk): opened FraudOps ticket FO-2026-198. added playbook steps: 1) block IP 203.0.113.12, 2) disable any accounts created by the key, 3) notify infra to rotate any webhook secrets used by that key.

Jesse (Finance): closing loop with accounting: mark GL reversal entries and tag for chargeback monitoring for next 45 days. add memo for auditors: "Pattern of unauthorized API usage resulting in three customer disputes; refunds issued and evidence submitted."

Noah (Support): will follow up with customers once bank decisions come back. thanks team. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: dispute_response submitted for DB-7781, DB-7782, DB-7783 (status: evidence_submitted)

Maya (BillingOps): closing thread. will reopen if any dispute is lost and a chargeback posts. "
